name: stackdome
description: Agent skills for deploying and managing applications on Stackdome, a self-hosted PaaS.

interface.description: Deploy and manage applications on Stackdome.
interface.longDescription: Teaches the agent to work with Stackdome, a self-hosted PaaS: installing the CLI, authenticating with an API token, authoring a stackfile from the current repo, deploying, and verifying the release reached a healthy state.
capabilities: Install and authenticate the Stackdome CLI
Author and validate a stackfile from an existing repo
Deploy an application to a Stackdome instance
Verify a deploy reached a released, healthy state
interface.defaultPrompt: Deploy this repo to my Stackdome instance.
